categories.title: Feedback & Overlays
categories.ja: フィードバック・オーバーレイ

objects.name: Filled Button
objects.desc: 最も強調したい主要アクション用。サイズ違い・アイコン付き・無効状態。
objects.spec: Primary iOS filled button in accent blue. Show three sizes stacked: Large (height 50, radius 14, ~280px wide, 17px semibold label), Medium (height 44 capsule-ish radius 12), Small (height 34 capsule, 15px). Add an icon+label variant (e.g. plus or paperplane icon) and a disabled state (fill-3 bg, label-3 text). Press: scale .97 + slight brightness change with spring easing; hover (pointer devices) subtle lighten; :focus-visible ring (3px accent at 35% with 2px offset). Label row under each like a tiny caption is NOT needed — keep it clean; instead group variants with small footnote labels left-aligned if helpful.

objects.name: Tinted Button
objects.desc: 薄い色面で控えめに強調。複数カラーのパレット付き。
objects.spec: Tinted buttons: background = color at ~15% (light) / ~22% (dark) via color-mix, label in the full color, semibold. Show a palette row of capsule tinted buttons in blue, green, orange, pink, purple, each with a small leading icon (e.g. heart, star-fill, bell-fill, bookmark-fill, sparkles) and short Japanese labels (お気に入り, スター, 通知, 保存, おすすめ). Plus one large full-width tinted button and a pair of side-by-side tinted buttons (e.g. 『あとで』『今すぐ読む』). Soft vector: generous radius, gentle press (scale .96, bg slightly deeper). Clicking a palette button toggles it to a filled state (solid color, white label) with a smooth color transition — demonstrates selected state.

objects.name: Gray & Plain Button
objects.ja: グレー／テキストボタン
objects.desc: 二次アクション用のグレーボタン、文字だけのボタン、枠線ボタン。
objects.spec: Secondary buttons: (1) Gray filled (fill-3 bg, label color text) in large and capsule small sizes, (2) Plain text buttons in accent color (『キャンセル』, 『詳細を見る』 with trailing chevron-right), (3) Bordered/outline button (1px separator border, label text), (4) an inline text link inside a sentence footnote. Pressed state for plain buttons = opacity .35 → fade back (iOS highlight). Show a realistic pairing: a dialog-like footer with 『キャンセル』(gray) and 『続ける』(filled accent) side by side. Keep spacing rhythm on an 8pt grid.

objects.name: Destructive Button
objects.desc: 削除など取り消せない操作用。長押しで確定するタイプも。
objects.spec: Destructive actions in system red: filled red button (『アカウントを削除』 with trash-fill icon), tinted red, and plain red text button (『削除』). Main feature: a 'hold to confirm' button 『長押しで削除』 — pressing and holding fills a red progress layer left→right over ~1.2s (with label change to 『そのまま押し続ける…』); releasing early springs back; completing triggers a success state (checkmark + 『削除しました』) with a subtle shake-free scale pop, then auto-resets after ~1.8s. Works with pointer and keyboard (Space/Enter hold). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

objects.name: Icon Button
objects.desc: 背景を透かすガラス素材の丸いアイコンボタン。
objects.spec: Liquid-glass style circular icon buttons over the colorful wallpaper stage: sizes 36 / 44 / 56. Glass recipe: translucent white (var(--glass-bg)), backdrop-filter var(--glass-blur), hairline inner border var(--glass-border), specular highlight (inset top light, subtle radial sheen), soft drop shadow var(--glass-shadow). Icons: xmark, square-and-arrow-up, ellipsis, heart (toggles to heart-fill pink with a bounce on click), plus. Also a glass capsule button with icon+label (『共有』). Press: scale .92 and glass brightens. Put some colorful shapes / an art tile behind part of the buttons so the translucency/blur is visible. Also show the same circular buttons in a 'tinted glass' variant (accent-colored glass).

objects.name: Loading Button
objects.desc: 押すと読み込み中→完了へ形が変わるボタン。
objects.spec: Vivid: a gradient pill button (var(--grad-vivid)) 『購入する ¥480』. Click → width morphs smoothly into a circle (height 52) with a white spinner → after ~1.6s morphs to a green success circle with an animated stroke-drawn checkmark → then expands back to the pill showing 『購入済み』 and after a moment resets to initial. Also include a standard blue filled button 『保存』 that shows an inline spinner + 『保存中…』 then 『保存しました』 with checkmark. No layout jump in surrounding content (reserve width/height). Glow shadow under the vivid button tinted from the gradient. Respect reduced motion.

objects.name: Text Field
objects.desc: ラベル・消去ボタン・パスワード表示・エラー表示付きの入力欄。
objects.spec: Form text fields in an inset-grouped card (bg-grouped-2, radius 12): rows 『名前』, 『メールアドレス』 (email), 『パスワード』 with eye/eye-slash toggle. Clear button (xmark-circle-fill, label-3) appears only when the focused field has text. Validation: email field shows red message below the group 『有効なメールアドレスを入力してください』 when blurred with invalid text, with red tint on the row label. Also a standalone 'floating label' field (rounded rect filled fill-3, label floats up & shrinks on focus/filled) to show a second style. Caret color = accent. Focus: no heavy outline; subtle accent ring for floating field. Japanese placeholders.

objects.name: Search Bar
objects.desc: 虫眼鏡・音声入力・キャンセル付き。ガラスの浮遊タイプも。
objects.spec: Two search bars: (1) iOS standard search field (fill-3 bg, radius 10, height 36, magnifyingglass + placeholder 『検索』 + mic-fill at right). On focus, field shrinks and 『キャンセル』 slides in from the right; typing replaces mic with xmark-circle-fill clear button; below, a small result list (inset grouped) filters live from ~8 items (e.g. app/settings names in Japanese) with matched substring bolded; empty state 『“xxx”の結果はありません』. Cancel clears and blurs. (2) A floating liquid-glass capsule search bar (height 48) over the wallpaper with recent-search chips under it (glass chips with clock icon) — clicking a chip fills the search. Put both in a column; standard one sits in a light card panel so it reads correctly.

objects.name: Toggle Switch
objects.desc: iOS標準のオン/オフスイッチ。押下時にノブが伸びる。
objects.spec: Pixel-faithful iOS switch: track 51x31, radius full, off = fill (rgba gray), on = green; knob 27x27 white with shadow (0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15), 0 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)). While pressed the knob stretches to ~33px wide (anchored to its side). Smooth 250ms spring. Build on a real <input type=checkbox role=switch> for accessibility (keyboard Space toggles), visually hidden input. Show inside an inset grouped list with colored icon squares: 機内モード (orange airplane), Wi-Fi (blue wifi), Bluetooth→ use 『おやすみモード』 (indigo moon-fill), 通知 (red bell-fill). Also show color variants (blue, orange, pink tracks) and a disabled switch (opacity .5). Toggling 機内モード on should dim/disable the Wi-Fi row as a realistic dependency.

objects.name: Segmented Control
objects.ja: セグメントコントロール
objects.desc: 選択した項目へつまみがスライドする切り替え。
objects.spec: iOS segmented control: container fill-3 (var(--segment-bg)), radius 9, height 32, padding 2; thumb = var(--segment-thumb) with radius 7 and shadow (0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04)) sliding with spring easing to the selected segment; separators between unselected segments fade when adjacent to thumb. Selected label semibold. While pressing on the thumb it scales to .95. Examples: 2-seg (『日』『週』), 3-seg (『すべて』『未読』『フラグ付き』) controlling a content area below that cross-fades a short list/summary, 4-seg (『日』『週』『月』『年』) driving a tiny bar chart that animates bar heights. Keyboard: arrow keys move selection (role=tablist/radiogroup semantics).

objects.name: Slider
objects.desc: 標準の細いスライダーと、コントロールセンター風の太いスライダー。
objects.spec: (1) Standard iOS slider in a light panel: track 4px (fill), filled portion accent, knob 28px white circle with shadow; min/max icons (speaker-fill, speaker-wave-2-fill); live value label. (2) Control-Center style thick vertical sliders (width 64, height 150, radius 20) in glass over the wallpaper: brightness (sun-max-fill) and volume (speaker-wave-2-fill); fill is white rising from the bottom; the icon at the bottom changes color when fill covers it. On drag the slider subtly stretches (scaleY 1.03) like iOS rubber-banding when pulled beyond limits. Implement with pointer events (pointerdown/move/up with setPointerCapture) + keyboard arrows; role=slider with aria-valuenow. (3) A horizontal thick glass slider (height 44) with a % readout.

objects.name: Stepper
objects.desc: ＋／−で数量を増減。数字がロールして変わる。
objects.spec: (1) iOS stepper: 94x32, fill-3 bg, radius 8, two halves with minus/plus glyphs, center hairline separator; pressed half darkens; disabled at min/max (label-3). Placed in a list row 『人数』 with value 『2人』. (2) Soft large quantity stepper: pill (height 52) with circular − / + buttons (tinted), the number in the middle rolls vertically (old number slides out up/down, new slides in) with rounded font (var(--font-rounded)), min 0 max 10; when 0 the minus turns into trash icon. (3) A cart-like card: product art thumbnail (art class), name, price that recalculates total 『合計 ¥2,400』 as quantity changes. Press-and-hold auto-repeats after 400ms.

objects.name: Checkmark List
objects.desc: 単一選択（✓）と複数選択（丸チェック）のリスト。
objects.spec: (1) Single-select inset grouped list with section header 『並べ替え』: options 『日付』『名前』『サイズ』『種類』; selected row shows accent checkmark at trailing edge (animated draw/scale-in). (2) Multi-select list with leading circular checkboxes (22px; empty = 1.5px label-3 ring, selected = accent filled circle with white checkmark, pop animation) — items like a reminders list 『牛乳を買う』『資料を送る』『ジムに行く』『本を返す』; selected items' text gets secondary color + strike-through for a reminders feel; header shows 『2件選択中』 with 『すべて選択』 plain button. Rows highlight on press. Use real inputs (radio/checkbox) hidden for a11y.

objects.name: Wheel Picker
objects.desc: 回転式の時刻ピッカー。立体的に回るホイール。
objects.spec: iOS wheel time picker: three columns 午前/午後, 時 (1–12), 分 (00–59), row height 32/34, 5 visible rows, center selection band (fill-3 radius 8), text 21–23px; rows away from center rotateX and fade/shrink to emulate a cylinder (compute per-row transform on scroll). Use scroll-snap columns (mouse wheel, touch, and drag-to-scroll with pointer) with top/bottom gradient masks. Selected value shown above in a compact pill row: 『アラーム』 label + compact time button (fill-3 pill showing e.g. 午前 7:30) that updates live. Also a compact date pill 『2026年10月2日』 next to it. Keyboard: arrow up/down in a focused column. Smooth, no jank (use requestAnimationFrame).

objects.name: Large Title Nav Bar
objects.desc: スクロールで大見出しが小さなタイトルに縮むナビゲーションバー。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (phone height ~640): a scrollable screen with a Large Title 『ライブラリ』 (34px bold, -0.4px tracking) with trailing circular buttons (ellipsis-circle style / plus), a search field under it, and editorial content: e.g. big section headers (『最近追加した項目』) with a horizontally scrolling row of art tiles + a list. On scroll: the large title scrolls away and an inline compact title (17px semibold) fades in at the top bar center; the top bar gains a translucent material (blur) + hairline separator only after content scrolls under it. Overscroll stretch not required. The scroll container is inside the phone screen; top bar is position:sticky/absolute within the screen. Content must start below the status bar (var(--phone-safe-top)).

objects.name: Tab Bar
objects.desc: 画面下のタブ切り替え。浮遊ガラス型とクラシック型の2種。
objects.spec: Two .phone frames side by side (phone height ~600): (A) iOS-26-like floating liquid-glass tab bar: capsule (height ~62) floating above content with margins, 4 tabs (house-fill ホーム, square-grid-2x2-fill 見つける, play-rectangle-fill ビデオ, person-fill プロフィール) icon over 10px label; the selected tab has a lighter glass lozenge highlight that slides between tabs with a spring and slight stretch; a separate circular glass search button to the right. Content scrolls under it (put colorful art content so the glass is visible). (B) Classic iOS tab bar: full-width, translucent material with top hairline, 5 tabs, selected = accent tint, unselected = gray; a red badge 『3』 on one tab. Tapping tabs switches a visible screen title/content in each phone. Labels Japanese.

objects.name: Toolbar
objects.desc: 画面下部のツールボタン列。選択モードで内容が切り替わる。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame showing a photo grid (art tiles, 3 columns, 2px gaps) with a top bar 『写真』 and trailing 『選択』 button. Bottom: a floating glass toolbar (grouped capsules: left capsule with share, center label 『48枚の写真』, right capsule with trash/ellipsis). Tapping 『選択』 enters selection mode: top button becomes 『キャンセル』, tapping tiles toggles a checkmark-circle-fill badge + dim, the toolbar label becomes 『2項目を選択中』 and share/trash become enabled (disabled when 0). Transitions between modes animate (cross-fade + slight slide). Use backdrop blur so photos are visible through the toolbar.

objects.name: Page Control
objects.desc: オンボーディング用のスワイプ画面とページ位置のドット。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame: an onboarding carousel with 3–4 pages, each with a vivid gradient backdrop (different gradient per page, using --grad-* tokens), a large glyph composition (big icon in a glowing glass circle), title (28px bold) and body text, all in white. Horizontal scroll-snap (swipe/drag/trackpad) plus tap on dots. Page dots at bottom: 8px dots, active dot elongates into a 22px capsule with smooth width animation and opacity changes; dots sit on a subtle glass capsule. Bottom button 『続ける』 (white filled pill with dark label) advances pages; on the last page it becomes 『はじめる』. Parallax: glyph moves slightly faster than the page during scroll.

objects.name: Sidebar
objects.desc: iPad/Mac風の2ペイン。サイドメニューで内容を切り替え。
objects.spec: An iPad-like split view window (≈ 900x520, radius 20, shadow, max-width 100% and graceful at narrow widths — collapse sidebar to an overlay with a sidebar-left toggle button under ~620px of available width). Sidebar (≈ 260px, material/bg-2): title 『メモ』-like app header, search field, sections with collapsible disclosure headers (chevron rotates): 『ライブラリ』 (tray-fill すべて 128, star-fill お気に入り 12, clock-fill 最近の項目, trash-fill ゴミ箱) and 『フォルダ』 (folder-fill items in different colors with counts). Selected row = accent rounded-rect with white text/icon when sidebar focused. Main pane: toolbar with sidebar toggle (sidebar-left), title updating to the selected item, a list of items with dates; toggling the sidebar animates its width collapse.

objects.name: Grouped List
objects.ja: グループリスト（設定風）
objects.desc: 設定アプリ風。カラーアイコン・詳細値・›付きの一覧。
objects.spec: Settings-style inset grouped list (width ~360): top profile cell (60px avatar with initials gradient, name 『佐藤 春』, subtitle 『アカウント、iCloud、メディアと購入』, chevron). Then sections: [機内モード (orange airplane) with switch, Wi-Fi (blue wifi) detail 『Home-5G』, モバイル通信 (green antenna-radiowaves)], [通知 (red bell-fill), サウンドと触覚 (pink speaker-wave-2-fill), 集中モード (indigo moon-fill), スクリーンタイム (purple timer)], [一般 (gray gearshape-fill) with red badge 『1』, プライバシー (blue hand / lock-fill)]. Icon squares 29x29 radius 7 white glyph ~17px. Rows height 44, text 17px, detail label-2, chevron label-3 13px; separators inset to text start. Section footer text example. Pressed row background = fill-4 → gray highlight like iOS. Also a section header in caps-like footnote style.

objects.name: Swipe Actions Row
objects.ja: スワイプアクション行
objects.desc: 行を横にスワイプして削除・フラグなどを出すメール風リスト。
objects.spec: Mail-style list (inset grouped or full-width in a card, width ~360) with 4–5 rows: unread blue dot, sender bold, time + chevron, subject, 2-line preview (label-2). Drag left (pointer events, horizontal intent detection, rubber-band past limits) reveals trailing actions: 『その他』 (gray, ellipsis), 『フラグ』 (orange, flag-fill), 『ゴミ箱』 (red, trash-fill) — each icon above label. Drag right reveals leading 『未開封』/『開封』 (blue). Release snaps open/closed with spring; full swipe left past ~70% performs delete: the red action expands to fill, then the row height collapses smoothly and is removed. Tap elsewhere closes open row. Include a small 『リセット』 plain button to restore rows. Must not trigger text selection while dragging (user-select:none, touch-action: pan-y).

objects.name: Feature Card
objects.desc: App Store「Today」風の大きな特集カード。タップで記事に展開。
objects.spec: Two editorial cards side by side (wrap on narrow): (1) Tall feature card (≈ 340x420, radius 20, shadow-2): full-bleed art background, top-left eyebrow 『今日のおすすめ』 (13px semibold uppercase-ish, white 70%), giant headline (28–32px heavy, tight leading) 『夜を撮る、新しい方法』, bottom sub copy and a bottom 'app row' on a blurred material strip (app icon squircle, name, 『入手』 tinted pill button). (2) A light editorial card with large typographic headline on white/bg-grouped-2, small art inset. Press: card scales to .97 (spring). Click card (1) → it expands within the stage into a reading view (art header + article paragraphs + close xmark glass button) using a smooth FLIP-like transform; close returns it. Keep everything within the stage.

objects.name: Widget
objects.desc: ホーム画面ウィジェット（小・中）。天気・カレンダー・フィットネス等。
objects.spec: Home-screen widgets on the wallpaper stage, true iOS proportions (small 158x158, medium 338x158, radius 22, continuous-corner feel). Include: Weather small (gradient sky blue, 『東京』, big 『24°』, cloud-sun-fill, 『晴れ時々曇り』, 『最高27° 最低19°』); Calendar small (red weekday 『金曜日』, big date 『2』, next event lines with colored bars); Medium fitness/activity widget (three concentric activity rings in red/green/cyan with numbers 『ムーブ 420/500kcal』 etc. on dark bg); Small photo memory widget (art + 『1年前の今日』 caption overlay); Medium reminders/to-do widget (soft pastel). App name labels (white, 12px, text-shadow) under each widget like on the home screen. Subtle press scale. Layout as a 2-column home-screen-like grid with app icon placeholders squircles (60px, radius ~13.5) in one row for scale reference.

objects.name: Now Playing Card
objects.desc: 音楽プレイヤー。アートワークの色が背景ににじむ没入型。
objects.spec: Immersive music player card (≈ 340 wide): background = heavily blurred, saturated version of the album art (use the same art class scaled up + filter blur(60px) saturate(1.6) behind, plus dark overlay). Album art 280x280 radius 12 with deep shadow; it scales down slightly (to .85) when paused like Apple Music. Title 『夜明けのグラデーション』 (20px semibold, white) + artist (white 60%), ellipsis-circle & star buttons. Scrubber: thin track (white 20%) with white fill, elapsed 『1:12』 / remaining 『-2:31』; hovering/dragging thickens the track; draggable. Controls: backward-fill, play-fill/pause-fill (morph), forward-fill — big white glyphs, press = scale .85 + translucent circle flash. Volume slider with speaker icons. When playing, progress advances in real time.

objects.name: Alert
objects.desc: 画面中央に出る確認ダイアログ。2ボタン型と縦積み型。
objects.spec: Two trigger buttons (glass capsules) on the wallpaper stage: 『削除の確認』 and 『3択アラート』. Presenting: dim scrim fades in over the stage (position:absolute inset 0 within the stage), alert scales from 1.15→1 with opacity (iOS present animation). Alert: width 270, radius 14 (or modern larger radius ~20 if it looks better), thick material (glass blur + bg), title 17px semibold centered, message 13px; buttons separated by hairlines: horizontal pair 『キャンセル』 (regular) | 『削除』 (red, semibold if preferred); vertical stack variant with 3 buttons (『保存』, 『保存しない』, 『キャンセル』 bold). Button press highlights cell. Dismiss animates opacity out. Escape closes; focus moves into alert and returns. Optional text-field alert not required.

objects.name: Action Sheet
objects.desc: 下からせり上がる選択肢の一覧。キャンセルは分離。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (height ~620) showing a profile/photo context screen with a button 『写真を変更』. Tapping slides up an iOS action sheet from the bottom (with spring, scrim fade): a rounded group (radius 14, material) with optional title/message 『プロフィール写真』, options with leading/trailing icons: 『写真を撮る』(camera-fill), 『写真を選択』(photo), 『ファイルを選択』(folder-fill), destructive 『写真を削除』 (red); separated 『キャンセル』 group (bold, accent). Each option 57px tall, 20px label in accent. Tap option or scrim dismisses (slide down). Choosing an option shows a tiny confirmation inside the screen (e.g., text update).

objects.name: Bottom Sheet
objects.desc: つまみ付きのハーフモーダル。ドラッグで高さを切り替え。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame: a map-like background (draw a stylized map with CSS: soft land color, roads as lines, a park area, a blue location dot with pulsing halo, a pin). A persistent bottom sheet with 3 detents: small (~110px, shows search field 『場所を検索』), medium (~50%), large (~92%, background screen scales down slightly .94 and dims like iOS page sheet stacking). Sheet: bg (material thick), radius 12–20 top corners, grabber (36x5, fill). Draggable via pointer on the grabber/header with velocity-based snapping and rubber-band past limits; content inside scrolls only at large detent. Content: search field, a 『よく使う項目』 row of circular tinted buttons (house-fill 自宅, bag→ use cart-fill 職場? choose sensible), a 『最近の検索』 list. Also tap grabber cycles detents.

objects.name: HUD & Toast
objects.desc: 「コピーしました」等の一時表示。上部・中央・下部の3種。
objects.spec: Three trigger buttons on the stage: 『上部トースト』, 『中央HUD』, 『取り消しバー』. (1) Top capsule toast (glass, Dynamic-Island-like drop from top of stage): checkmark-circle-fill green + 『リンクをコピーしました』, auto-hide 2s, spring in/out. (2) Center HUD: 150x150 glass square radius 24 with big checkmark drawn via stroke animation + 『完了』; also a variant progress HUD with spinner 『読み込み中』 → turns into checkmark. (3) Bottom undo snackbar: dark/glass capsule 『1件の写真を削除しました』 + 『取り消す』 accent button, with a thin countdown progress line (5s); clicking 取り消す shows a short 『元に戻しました』. Multiple triggers queue/replace gracefully. All positioned absolute within the stage.

objects.name: Notification Banner
objects.desc: 上から降りてくる通知と、ロック画面の通知スタック。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (status bar white, data-status=light) with a lock-screen look: wallpaper art background, big clock 『9:41』 (heavy, ~80px, rounded or display font, white with slight translucency), date 『10月2日 金曜日』 above it. Notification stack near bottom: grouped glass notifications (radius 22, material, app icon squircle 38px with glyph, app name caps-ish, time 『今』『5分前』, title bold, body 2 lines); stacked group shows 2 cards peeking behind; click expands the stack (cards fan out) and 『表示を減らす』 collapses. A trigger button outside or a small control 『通知を受け取る』 makes a new notification drop in from the top (banner style, spring), stays 3s, then slides up; swipe-up (drag) dismisses early. Also show the Dynamic Island briefly expanding into a pill with a tiny live activity (timer 『04:59』) when a button is pressed.

objects.name: Activity Indicator
objects.ja: インジケーター／スケルトン
objects.desc: くるくる回る読み込み表示と、骨組みのスケルトン表示。
objects.spec: (1) iOS activity indicator: 8 spokes (medium 20px) and 12 spokes? — iOS uses 8 spokes with stepped opacity rotation; build with CSS (spokes as rounded bars, animation steps(8)) at medium and large (37px) sizes, plus white-on-dark variant on a dark chip. (2) Inline 『読み込み中…』 row with spinner. (3) Pull-to-refresh demo: a small list in a card; dragging down (pointer) reveals spinner that grows with pull distance (spokes appear progressively), release beyond threshold triggers refresh for 1.2s then list updates with a new item sliding in. (4) Skeleton loading card: avatar circle + text lines + image block with shimmer gradient sweep (respect reduced motion), a 『読み込む』 button swaps skeleton ↔ real content (cross-fade).

objects.name: Progress
objects.ja: プログレス（バー／リング）
objects.desc: 進捗バー、ダウンロードリング、アクティビティリング風の円。
objects.spec: (1) Linear progress: thin iOS progress view (4px, accent fill, fill track) with label 『ダウンロード中… 64%』 + a thicker vivid gradient bar (8px, var(--grad-vivid)) with moving sheen. (2) App-Store-style download button: 『入手』 tinted pill → tap → becomes a circular progress ring (stroke accent, square stop button in center) that fills over ~3s → turns into 『開く』 pill. (3) Activity rings: three concentric rings (move red→pink gradient, exercise green→lime, stand cyan→blue) with rounded caps, gradient along the stroke (use conic-gradient masks or SVG with gradients + an end-cap shadow), animate from 0 to values on load and on 『もう一度』 button; one ring exceeds 100% showing overlap with darker cap shadow. Legend with numbers in rounded font.

objects.name: Badge
objects.desc: アプリアイコンの赤い数字、ドット、NEW・LIVEなどのラベル。
objects.spec: (1) App icon squircles (60px, radius 13.5 with continuous-curve feel, vivid gradient fills and white glyphs: message-fill green, envelope-fill blue, bell-fill red, calendar white) with red count badges (min 20px height, 13px semibold white, 1px? no border; numbers 1, 12, 99+), app labels beneath. Click an icon → its count bumps +1 with a spring pop. (2) Dot badge (8–10px red) on an icon; status dots (online green with 2px bg ring, away yellow, busy red). (3) Pill/tag badges: 『NEW』 (vivid gradient), 『LIVE』 (red with pulsing dot), 『限定』 (orange tinted), 『β』 (gray), 『おすすめ』 (sparkles + purple tinted), 『認証済み』 with checkmark-seal-fill blue. (4) A segmented/tab with a badge to show placement.

objects.name: Context Menu
objects.ja: コンテキストメニュー
objects.desc: 長押しで対象が浮き上がり、メニューが開く。
objects.spec: A photo tile (art, 200x200 radius 16) and a message bubble on the stage. Long-press (pointer down 450ms; also right-click / click on a hint button for desktop) → the stage background blurs+dims (overlay inside stage), the pressed item lifts (scale 1.05→1, shadow-3) and a glass menu appears below/above it (width 250, radius 14–18, material) with items: 『コピー』(doc-on-doc), 『共有』(square-and-arrow-up), 『お気に入り』(heart → toggles), separator thicker gap, 『削除』(trash, red). Icons trailing, labels leading, 17px. A top row of 3 quick action buttons (glass squares) optional. Pressing an item highlights, then menu dismisses with scale/fade back. Hovering/dragging over items highlights them (drag-to-select from the long-press). Click outside or Escape closes.

objects.name: Avatar
objects.desc: サイズ違いのプロフィール画像、オンライン表示、重ね表示。
objects.spec: (1) Size scale row: 24 / 32 / 44 / 64 / 88 avatars using the shared avatar gradients + initials (rounded font, white, size-proportional) and one image avatar (art class) and one placeholder (person-fill gray silhouette on gray gradient, like iOS Contacts). (2) Status indicators: online green dot with bg-colored ring (scaled to size), a 'moon' DND indicator, an unread count. (3) Stacked group avatars (overlapping -10px with bg ring) + 『+5』 counter chip; hover spreads them apart. (4) A contact row card: 64px avatar, name 『佐藤 春』, 『@haru.photo』, quick action circular tinted buttons (message-fill, phone-fill, video-fill, envelope-fill) with labels like iOS Contacts. Soft vector: gentle pastel shadows.

objects.name: Chat Bubbles
objects.desc: iMessage風の吹き出し。入力して送信もできる。
objects.spec: Chat view in a card (width ~360, height ~520, bg plain): header with avatar + name 『ミオ』 (centered small avatar over name like iMessage). Messages: timestamp separator 『今日 9:41』; received bubbles (fill gray: #E9E9EB light / #262628 dark) and sent bubbles (blue #0B84FE→ use accent, white text) with authentic curved tails drawn via CSS pseudo-elements or SVG — tail only on the last bubble of a consecutive group; max-width 75%; 17px text, padding 7px 12px, radius 18. Include an emoji-only large message, an image bubble (art) with rounded corners, a tapback reaction (heart badge on the corner of a received bubble), 『既読 9:42』 under last sent. Typing indicator bubble (three dots bouncing in a gray bubble with little trailing circles). Composer at bottom: plus circle button, capsule text field 『iMessage』 placeholder→ use 『メッセージ』, send button (accent circle with arrow-up) appearing when text present. Sending appends a new sent bubble with a slide-up animation and auto-scroll; then the other side shows typing and replies after ~1.2s.

objects.name: Control Tile
objects.desc: コントロールセンター風のタイル群。タップで点灯。
objects.spec: Control Center grid on the wallpaper (dimmed with a dark translucent layer to look like Control Center): a 2x2 connectivity platter (glass square, radius 28) containing 4 circular toggles: airplane (orange when on), antenna-radiowaves (green), wifi (blue), dot-radiowaves→ Bluetooth-like (blue). A media mini-player tile (art thumbnail, title, play/pause). Focus tile 『集中モード』 (moon-fill, toggles indigo with label 『おやすみ中』). Two vertical sliders (brightness sun-max-fill, volume speaker-wave-2-fill) as tall glass pills with white fill. Small square tiles: flashlight-on-fill (turns white bg with dark glyph when on), timer, camera-fill, a 『画面ミラーリング』 like wide tile. Glass: white translucent with blur; ON state = solid color or white. Press: scale .94 spring. Use a consistent 4-column grid with 16px gaps, tile unit ~68px.

objects.name: Photo Post
objects.desc: フィードの写真投稿。ダブルタップでいいね、複数枚スワイプ。
objects.spec: Feed post (width ~375, edge-to-edge media): header row (avatar 32 with vivid story ring, username 『haru.photo』 bold + checkmark-seal-fill blue verified, subline 『京都・嵐山』, ellipsis). Media: 4:5 carousel of 3 art slides (scroll-snap, swipe/drag) with 『1/3』 dark glass pill top-right and dot indicator below. Action row: heart (toggle → heart-fill red with bounce), bubble-right, paperplane, bookmark at right (toggle fill). 『いいね！1,284件』 (count updates on like), caption 『haru.photo 朝の竹林。光がやわらかかった。#京都 #朝散歩』 with hashtags in link color and 『…続きを読む』 expanding, 『コメント48件をすべて見る』 secondary, time 『2時間前』 caption2. Double-tap/double-click media → big white heart pops center (scale 0→1.2→1, then fades) and likes. All text Japanese.

objects.name: Text Thread
objects.ja: テキスト投稿スレッド
objects.desc: 文字が主役のタイムライン投稿。返信をつなぐ線と引用カード。
objects.spec: Text-first thread (width ~380): parent post with avatar 40 column + a vertical connector line running down to the reply's avatar; name 『蓮 / Ren』 bold + handle 『@ren.design』 secondary + 『·』 + time 『3時間』; body in larger editorial type (17px, line-height 1.45) with a @mention and #hashtag and a URL in link color; a quoted post embed (bordered card radius 14 with mini avatar, name, text); a link preview card (art image top, domain small, title semibold). Action row with counts: bubble-right 返信 24, arrow-2-squarepath リポスト 112 (toggles green), heart いいね 1.2K (toggles pink), square-and-arrow-up; counts animate (digit roll) on toggle. Reply post below connected by the line, smaller. Typography is the hero: careful hierarchy, generous whitespace, tabular numbers.

objects.name: Stories Row
objects.desc: グラデーションの輪が付いたストーリーのアイコン列。
objects.spec: Horizontally scrolling row (no visible scrollbar, scroll-snap, drag-to-scroll with pointer) of story avatars: 64px avatar inside a 74px ring. First = 『あなた』 own story with blue plus badge (plus-circle-fill with bg ring). Unseen = vivid conic/linear gradient ring (orange→pink→purple, var(--grad-story)) with a 2–3px bg gap between ring and avatar; seen = thin gray ring (label-4); one 『親しい友達』 with green ring; one with a 『LIVE』 red pill badge overlapping bottom of ring (white border). Names under (12px, truncated). Clicking an unseen story animates the ring: brief rotation/spinner (dashed loading) then turns gray (seen). Show the row in a header context (app title bar 『ホーム』 with heart & paperplane icons above) for realism.

objects.name: Story Viewer
objects.ja: ストーリービューアー
objects.desc: 全画面のストーリー表示。上部の進捗バーで自動送り。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (data-status=light, phone height ~640): full-bleed art (3–4 stories with different art classes, each with overlaid content: one with large text sticker, one with a poll sticker (2 options, tap to vote shows %), one with a location sticker). Top: segmented progress bars (2px, white 35% track, white fill) auto-advancing (5s each) using requestAnimationFrame; header row (avatar 32, 『mio_k』 + 『3時間』, ellipsis, xmark). Tap right third → next, left third → previous; press-and-hold pauses (and hides UI chrome with fade); after last story → loop back with a 『もう一度見る』 hint. Bottom: capsule reply field 『メッセージを送信』 (white 40% border), heart and paperplane icons; tapping heart pops. Subtle top/bottom gradient scrims for legibility.

objects.name: Short Video
objects.desc: 縦型ショート動画のUI。右側のアクション列と回るディスク。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (data-status=light): full-screen 'video' = art layer with slow Ken-Burns animation (scale/translate loop) + vignette. Top: tabs 『フォロー中 | おすすめ』 (selected white bold with small underline, other 60%), search icon right, live icon left. Right action rail (bottom-right): creator avatar 48 with a red/accent plus badge (click → turns to checkmark and shrinks away), heart-fill (white, toggles red with burst) + 『12.4万』, bubble-right 『1,024』, bookmark-fill 『8,210』, arrow-up-right/share 『3,301』, and a spinning record disc (art circle with dark ring, rotates when playing) with floating music notes. Bottom-left: 『@sora_travel』 bold, caption with hashtags (2 lines, 『もっと見る』), music marquee row (music-note + scrolling 『オリジナル楽曲 - sora_travel』). Bottom: a thin progress bar (white) advancing; tap video toggles pause (large translucent play-fill appears center, disc stops). Double-tap → hearts burst at pointer. Bottom tab bar (black) with a center 'create' plus button.

objects.name: Like Burst
objects.ja: いいねアニメーション
objects.desc: 押すとはじけるハート・スター・炎のリアクション。
objects.spec: Three large (56px) reaction buttons side by side, each on a soft card with a count below: heart (pink/red), star (yellow/orange), flame (orange/red). On activate: icon scales 0.6 → 1.25 → 1 (spring), an expanding ring (circle stroke) bursts and fades, 8–12 particles (small dots / mini shapes in 2–3 colors) shoot out radially and fade, color fills from outline to filled glyph; count increments with vertical digit roll (and decrements on un-like without burst). Also a double-tap demo: an art image tile (4:5, 260 wide); double-click/tap anywhere → large heart appears at the pointer position with pop + slight random tilt, floats up and fades, and the like state of the heart button is set. Use CSS/JS (no libraries), GPU-friendly transforms. Respect prefers-reduced-motion (simple fade only).

objects.name: Reaction Picker
objects.ja: リアクションピッカー
objects.desc: 長押しで絵文字リアクションのバーが出現。なぞって選択。
objects.spec: On the wallpaper stage: two chat messages / a post card. Long-press (450ms) or click a small 『リアクション』 hint button → a glass capsule reaction bar pops above the message (scale from origin with spring; items stagger in): ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 😡 👍 + a 'plus' circle. Hover/drag across emojis → the one under the pointer magnifies (dock-like, neighbours scale slightly) and lifts with a small label bubble (『大好き』『ウケる』『びっくり』『悲しい』『怒り』『いいね』). Release / click selects: the chosen emoji flies down to attach as a reaction chip at the bubble's corner (glass chip with emoji + count 『2』); selecting again removes it. Outside click / Escape closes. Emoji rendered with system emoji fonts ('Apple Color Emoji','Noto Color Emoji').

objects.name: Comment Thread
objects.desc: 返信がネストするコメント一覧と入力欄。
objects.spec: Comments sheet look (width ~375, height ~560 with internal scroll): grabber + title 『コメント』 centered + count. Comments: avatar 32, 『yuna』 bold 13px + 『2時間』 secondary, text 14–15px, row of 『返信する』 『翻訳を見る』 secondary small; trailing small heart with count (toggle pink, pop). A creator badge 『作成者』 pill on the author's comment and a pinned label (pin-fill 『固定済み』). Nested replies indented under parent (avatar 24), collapsed by default behind 『──  返信を表示（3件）』 that expands with height animation and turns into 『返信を非表示』. Bottom composer: quick emoji row (❤️🙌🔥👏😢😍😮😂) tapping inserts, avatar + capsule input 『コメントを追加…』 + 『投稿する』 accent text button (enabled when text). Posting adds the comment at the top with highlight fade. 『返信する』 prefills @username in input.

objects.name: Profile Header
objects.ja: プロフィールヘッダー
objects.desc: カバー画像・アイコン・フォロワー数・ハイライトのプロフィール。
objects.spec: Profile (width ~375): cover art (height 130) with a soft fade into bg; avatar 88 overlapping the cover with 4px bg ring and soft shadow; top-right glass buttons on cover (ellipsis, bell). Name 『佐藤 春』 (22px bold) + checkmark-seal-fill; handle 『@haru.photo』; bio 2–3 lines with a link 『haru.studio』 (link icon) and a category chip 『写真家』. Stats row: 『投稿 128』『フォロワー 12.4万』『フォロー中 312』 (numbers 17px bold, rounded/tabular, labels 13px secondary), tappable with press highlight. Buttons: 『フォローする』 filled (toggles to 『フォロー中』 gray with chevron-down and follower count +1 animation), 『メッセージ』 gray, person-badge-plus square gray. Highlights row: 64px circles with art + labels (『旅』『カフェ』『作品』『新規』 with plus). Tabs: square-grid-2x2-fill / play-rectangle-fill / person-crop-circle-fill (tagged) with sliding underline; switching cross-fades a small 3-col grid preview below (6 tiles). Soft palette & soft shadows.

objects.name: Follow Button
objects.desc: 3つの異なるデザイン方向で同じ「フォロー」を表現。
objects.spec: Same interaction in three design vectors, each as a row with mini user info (avatar 40, name, handle, 『フォローされています』 tag on one): (Clean) blue filled 『フォロー』 → on tap brief spinner → gray 『フォロー中』 with chevron-down; tapping 『フォロー中』 opens a small inline confirm popover 『@mio_k のフォローを解除しますか？』 with 『解除』(red) / 『キャンセル』. (Vivid) gradient pill 『フォロー』 → morphs (width animates) into a compact white-outlined pill with checkmark 『フォロー中』 + confetti-ish sparkle particles. (Glass) a row on a wallpaper strip (give this row its own wallpaper background panel inside the stage) with a glass capsule 『フォローする』 → glass turns tinted accent glass with checkmark. Also show 『フォローバック』 variant and 『リクエスト済み』 (private account, gray with clock icon) states as static examples. Each row labeled by its vector name in small caps footnote.

objects.name: Composer
objects.desc: 新規投稿の作成画面。文字数リング・画像添付・公開範囲。
objects.spec: Composer sheet (width ~375, radius 16 top, card look): header 『キャンセル』 (plain) | 『新規ポスト』 (semibold) | 『投稿する』 (accent capsule, disabled until text). Body: avatar 40 + auto-growing textarea placeholder 『いまどうしてる？』 (17px). Attached media: horizontal row of art thumbnails (radius 12, 120x150) each with glass xmark remove button; adding animates in. Audience pill 『全員が返信できます』 (globe icon, accent text) — click cycles 『フォロー中のみ』 (person-2-fill), 『メンションのみ』 (at). Bottom toolbar above keyboard area: photo (adds a random art thumbnail, max 4), number?/GIF text icon, chart-bar-fill (inserts a mini poll editor with 2 option fields), location-fill (adds a location chip 『渋谷区』), at, number(#). Right side: circular character counter ring (limit 140; ring progresses; at ≤20 remaining it grows and shows the number in orange; over limit red with negative number and 投稿 disabled) and a + (add thread) button.

objects.name: Activity Feed
objects.desc: いいね・フォロー・メンションのお知らせ一覧。
objects.spec: Activity list (width ~375, internal scroll height ~560): header 『アクティビティ』 + filter chips (soft capsules: 『すべて』『メンション』『フォロー』『いいね』 — selecting filters the list with fade). Sections 『今日』『今週』『今月』 (15px bold). Rows: (a) stacked 2 avatars + 『haru.photo、yuna、他12人があなたの投稿に「いいね！」しました。 2時間』 + post art thumbnail 44 radius 8 at right; (b) follow: avatar + 『kaito.dev があなたをフォローしました』 + 『フォローバック』 filled small button (toggles to 『フォロー中』 gray); (c) mention: avatar + quote of mention text in secondary + reply link; (d) comment like; (e) milestone with sparkles icon tile 『投稿が1,000いいね！を達成しました🎉』. Unread rows have a soft accent-tinted background that fades out when hovered/clicked. Small type icons on avatar corner (heart red, person-badge-plus blue, at purple, bubble green) as 18px badges.

objects.name: DM Inbox
objects.desc: メッセージ一覧。オンライン表示・未読・入力中表示。
objects.spec: Inbox (width ~375, height ~600 with internal scroll): header with 『haru.photo』 + chevron-down account switcher, square-and-pencil compose icon. Search field (fill-3). 'Notes' row: horizontal avatars (56) each with a small thought bubble note above (『☕️ 休憩中』, 『新曲いい』, 『ノートを残す』 for self) . Segmented/tabs 『メッセージ』『リクエスト（2）』. Rows (avatar 56): online green dot with bg ring; name (bold + unread blue dot at trailing when unread), preview 『写真を送信しました · 5分』 secondary or bold if unread; one row shows animated 『入力中』 three dots; one muted (bell-slash-fill small icon); one group chat with two overlapping avatars; trailing camera icon (label-2). Tapping a row marks read (bold → regular, dot disappears with fade). Swipe not needed.

objects.name: Poll
objects.desc: タップで投票すると結果バーがアニメーションで伸びる。
objects.spec: Poll card inside a post (width ~360): author row (avatar, name, time), question 『週末どこ行く？』 (17px semibold), 4 option buttons (capsule outline radius 12, height 44). On vote: options transform into result bars — fill widths animate from 0 to percentages with vivid gradient for the winner and fill-3 for others; percentages count up (number tween) at the right; chosen option shows checkmark-circle-fill and bold; footer 『1,025票 · 残り2日』 increments. 『投票を取り消す』 small plain button resets. Second mini-variant: a 2-option 'this or that' image poll (two art tiles side by side, tap one → overlay % with big rounded numerals). Vivid accent glow on chosen bar.

objects.name: Share Sheet
objects.desc: 人・アプリ・アクションが並ぶiOS風の共有シート。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame with an article/photo screen and a share button (square-and-arrow-up) in the toolbar. Tapping presents an iOS share sheet from the bottom (spring, dim scrim, background screen scales .96 & corners round like page-sheet stacking): header with thumbnail (art 44 radius 8), title 『嵐山の竹林』, subtitle 『haru.studio』, and an xmark close circle; 'Options ›' link. People row: 5 avatars (60px) with names and small app badges (message-fill green, envelope-fill blue squircle 20px at bottom-right). Apps row: generic colored squircle app icons (60px) with white glyphs & labels 『メッセージ』『メール』『メモ』『リマインダー』『その他』 (ellipsis on gray). Actions list grouped cards (radius 12): 『コピー』(doc-on-doc), 『リーディングリストに追加』(eyeglasses→ use bookmark), 『ブックマークを追加』(bookmark), 『お気に入りに追加』(star) with icons trailing. Draggable down to dismiss (grabber).

objects.name: Live Stream
objects.desc: ライブ配信画面。視聴者数・流れるコメント・浮き上がるハート。
objects.spec: Inside a .phone frame (data-status=light): full-bleed art (art-4 city night) with subtle animated grain/pan. Top-left: host chip (glass capsule: avatar 32 + 『kaito.dev』 + small 『フォロー』 pink pill). Top-right: 『LIVE』 red pill (pulsing dot) + viewer count glass pill (eye-fill 『1,284』 that fluctuates every few seconds with digit roll) + xmark. Bottom-left: live chat stream — messages (avatar 24 + bold name + text) appear from the bottom every ~1.2s, older ones move up and fade out via a top mask; include a system line 『yuna が参加しました』 and a gift line with gift-fill and a colored highlight. Right side: tapping the heart button (or double-tapping the stream) emits floating hearts (multi-color pastel) rising with wobble/sway and fading. Bottom bar: capsule input 『コメントする…』, gift-fill, square-and-arrow-up, heart-fill buttons (glass). Sending a comment adds it to the chat.

objects.name: Trends
objects.desc: 大きな順位数字が主役のトレンドランキングとハッシュタグ。
objects.spec: Editorial trends panel (width ~380): header 『トレンド』 (28px heavy) + subtitle 『いま話題』 + date. Horizontal hashtag chips (selectable filters: 『すべて』『テクノロジー』『エンタメ』『スポーツ』『グルメ』) — selecting re-renders list with stagger animation. Ranked list rows: giant numeral (40px, light/ultralight weight or heavy outline, tabular) 1–6, category line 『テクノロジー · トレンド』 (12px secondary), topic title 『#新しいiPhone』 (17px semibold), meta 『3.2万件のポスト』, and a tiny sparkline (SVG polyline) at right in green for rising (arrow-up-right) / a 『NEW』 tag for new entries; rank 1 gets a featured treatment with an art thumbnail. Hairline separators; magazine-like rhythm. Rows press-highlight. Ellipsis buttons optional.

objects.name: Media Grid
objects.desc: プロフィールの3列グリッド。複数枚・動画・固定のアイコン付き。
objects.spec: Profile media grid (width ~375): tab bar on top (3 icons: square-grid-2x2-fill, play-rectangle-fill, person-crop-circle-fill) with a 1px sliding underline indicator (label color). Grid: 3 columns, 2px gaps, aspect 4:5 (or 1:1 toggled by a small control 『1:1 / 4:5』), 12 tiles using various art classes (and background-position variations to look different). Overlays: square-on-square (multi) white icon top-right, play-fill + view count 『1.2万』 bottom-left on video tiles (with bottom gradient), pin-fill top-right on pinned. Hover/press: dim 15% overlay. Clicking a tile opens an in-stage lightbox: the tile zooms (FLIP) to a large view with dark backdrop, a header (avatar, name) and close; click/escape returns. Switching tabs cross-fades to a different set (reels grid 9:16 aspect with view counts).

objects.name: Mention & Verified
objects.ja: メンション・認証バッジ
objects.desc: @で候補が出る入力欄と、認証バッジの種類。
objects.spec: (1) Verified badge variants (checkmark-seal-fill): blue (個人), gold (企業), gray (公的機関) next to names in a small list with explanation text; a tooltip-like popover on hover/click explaining 『認証済みアカウント』. (2) Text composer field (multi-line contenteditable or textarea + overlay) where typing 『@』 opens a suggestion popover above the caret line listing users (avatar 32, name + verified badge, handle, 『フォロー中』 tag), filtered as you type (e.g. @h → haru.photo), keyboard ↑↓ Enter and click to select; selection inserts a styled mention token (accent text, slightly tinted bg). Typing 『#』 shows hashtag suggestions with post counts (『#京都 · 12.3万件』). Pre-fill some text with an existing mention so the styling is visible. Popover: radius 14, shadow-3, max 4 rows with internal scroll.

objects.name: Voice Message
objects.desc: 波形付きの音声メッセージと、長押しで録音するボタン。
objects.spec: (1) Received voice bubble (gray) and sent voice bubble (accent): play/pause circular button, waveform of ~36 rounded bars (deterministic heights) where played portion is opaque and remaining is 40%; duration counts down while playing (simulate playback with rAF, ~8–12s); tapping on waveform seeks; speed chip 『1x → 1.5x → 2x』 cycles. Only one plays at a time. (2) Recorder: a composer bar with a mic-fill button; press-and-hold (pointer) → recording state: bar turns into a recording strip with red pulsing dot, timer 『0:03』, live animated waveform bars scrolling from right, hint 『‹ スライドでキャンセル』 (dragging left beyond 80px cancels with a trash animation); a soft large mic circle grows under the finger with pulsing rings. Release → new sent voice bubble appears in the list with the recorded duration. Soft palette, rounded font for timers.
